concepts.name: Sequence transduction
concepts.definition: Tasks that map an input symbol sequence to an output symbol sequence, such as machine translation.

concepts.name: Encoder-decoder architecture
concepts.definition: A structure where an encoder maps input symbols to continuous representations and a decoder generates output symbols from them.

concepts.name: Recurrent neural networks
concepts.definition: Sequence models that compute hidden states step by step using prior hidden states.

concepts.name: Sequential computation constraint
concepts.definition: The training limitation caused when computation must proceed in sequence-position order.

concepts.name: Attention mechanisms
concepts.definition: Mechanisms that model dependencies by weighting information from positions according to relevance.

concepts.name: Transformer
concepts.definition: The paper's sequence transduction architecture based solely on attention, without recurrence or convolutions.

concepts.name: Self-attention
concepts.definition: Attention within a single sequence, relating positions of that sequence to compute its representation.

concepts.name: Convolutional sequence models
concepts.definition: Sequence transduction models that use convolutional layers as their main building block.

concepts.name: Encoder stack
concepts.definition: The Transformer encoder, composed of N identical layers with self-attention and feed-forward sublayers.

concepts.name: Decoder stack
concepts.definition: The Transformer decoder, composed of N identical layers with masked self-attention, encoder-decoder attention, and feed-forward sublayers.

concepts.name: Auto-regressive decoding
concepts.definition: Generating output symbols one at a time while conditioning on previously generated symbols.

concepts.name: Query-key-value attention
concepts.definition: An attention function that maps a query and key-value pairs to an output vector.

concepts.name: Softmax attention weights
concepts.definition: Weights on values obtained by applying softmax to query-key compatibility scores.

concepts.name: Scaled dot-product attention
concepts.definition: The attention computation softmax(QK^T / sqrt(dk))V used by the Transformer.

concepts.name: sqrt(dk) scaling
concepts.definition: Dividing dot products by sqrt(dk) to reduce softmax saturation for large key dimensions.

concepts.name: Additive attention
concepts.definition: An attention variant whose compatibility function is computed by a feed-forward network with one hidden layer.

concepts.name: Multi-head attention
concepts.definition: Parallel attention heads over learned projections whose outputs are concatenated and projected.

concepts.name: Attention heads
concepts.definition: Individual parallel attention layers within multi-head attention, often attending to different information.

concepts.name: Learned linear projections
concepts.definition: Learned matrices that project queries, keys, and values into per-head subspaces.

concepts.name: Encoder-decoder attention
concepts.definition: Decoder attention whose queries come from the decoder and keys and values come from the encoder output.

concepts.name: Masked decoder self-attention
concepts.definition: Decoder self-attention that blocks attention to subsequent output positions.

concepts.name: Position-wise feed-forward network
concepts.definition: A two-layer ReLU feed-forward network applied separately and identically at each position.

concepts.name: Residual connections
concepts.definition: Connections that add each sublayer input to its output before normalization.

concepts.name: Layer normalization
concepts.definition: Normalization applied after adding a sublayer output to its residual input.

concepts.name: Token embeddings
concepts.definition: Learned vector representations of input and output tokens with dimension dmodel.

concepts.name: Output softmax
concepts.definition: The learned linear transformation and softmax used to produce next-token probabilities.

concepts.name: Embedding and softmax weight sharing
concepts.definition: Sharing the same weight matrix between embeddings and the pre-softmax linear transformation.

concepts.name: Positional encoding
concepts.definition: Information added to embeddings so an attention-only model can use token order.

concepts.name: Sinusoidal positional encoding
concepts.definition: The fixed sine and cosine positional encoding used in the paper.

concepts.name: Learned positional embeddings
concepts.definition: A learned alternative to sinusoidal positional encodings that performed nearly identically in the reported experiments.

concepts.name: Long-range dependencies
concepts.definition: Dependencies between distant positions in a sequence, whose learnability depends on path length.

concepts.name: Computational complexity per layer
concepts.definition: The asymptotic amount of computation required by different layer types.

concepts.name: Parallelization
concepts.definition: The ability to compute positions simultaneously rather than sequentially within an example.

concepts.name: Maximum path length
concepts.definition: The longest computation path signals traverse between positions in a network.

concepts.name: Restricted self-attention
concepts.definition: A proposed variant where each position attends only to a neighborhood of size r.

concepts.name: Subword tokenization
concepts.definition: Byte-pair or word-piece tokenization used to form shared vocabularies for translation datasets.

concepts.name: Training data and batching
concepts.definition: The paper's use of WMT datasets and batches grouped by approximate sequence length and token count.

concepts.name: Adam optimizer schedule
concepts.definition: The training optimizer setup using Adam with specified beta values, epsilon, and a changing learning rate.

concepts.name: Learning-rate warmup
concepts.definition: The initial linear increase of learning rate before inverse-square-root decay.

concepts.name: Residual dropout
concepts.definition: Dropout applied to sublayer outputs and to embedding-plus-position sums during training.

concepts.name: Label smoothing
concepts.definition: A regularization method that makes targets less certain, improving accuracy and BLEU despite worse perplexity.

concepts.name: Beam search inference
concepts.definition: The decoding procedure used for reported translation and parsing outputs, with beam size and length penalty choices.

concepts.name: BLEU score
concepts.definition: The machine translation quality metric used to report English-German and English-French results.

concepts.name: Training cost in FLOPs
concepts.definition: The estimated floating-point operations used to compare model training expense.

concepts.name: Machine translation evaluation
concepts.definition: Evaluation on WMT 2014 English-German and English-French translation tasks.

concepts.name: Base and big Transformer configurations
concepts.definition: Two reported model sizes, with the big model using larger dimensions, more heads, and longer training.

concepts.name: Model variation ablation
concepts.definition: Experiments varying heads, dimensions, dropout, positional encoding, and model size to measure their effects.

concepts.name: English constituency parsing
concepts.definition: A non-translation task used to test whether the Transformer generalizes beyond machine translation.

concepts.name: Semi-supervised parsing setting
concepts.definition: A parsing setup using additional high-confidence and BerkeleyParser corpora beyond WSJ training data.

concepts.name: Attention visualizations
concepts.definition: Figures showing learned attention patterns such as long-distance dependencies and anaphora-related behavior.

concepts.name: Syntactic and semantic structure
concepts.definition: Sentence-structure behavior that some attention heads appear to capture.

concepts.name: Generalization to other tasks
concepts.definition: Evidence that the Transformer can be successfully applied outside translation.
